   767	/-- The phase bit `γ(u_X,u_Z,r_X,r_Z)` from `eq:gamma-value`.  It uses the
   768	fixed trace selected by `P.model`, as required by the paper's fixed
   769	self-dual-normal representation.  Blueprint
   770	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:331-367`; paper origin
   771	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1198-1212`.
   772	-/
   773	noncomputable def gammaValue (P : AdmissibleParams)
   774	    (uX uZ : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
   775	    (rX rZ : PauliScalar P) : ZMod 2 :=
   776	  fixedBinTrace P.model
   777	    (dotProduct (rX • indicatorVec uX) (rZ • indicatorVec uZ))
   778	
   779	/-- The commutation bit attached to a full Pauli ambient question, from
   780	`eq:gamma-value` in `def:pauli-win-predicate`, blueprint
   781	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:331-367`, paper origin
   782	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1198-1212`.
   783	-/
   784	noncomputable def pauliPairGamma (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P) : ZMod 2 :=
   785	  gammaValue P (pauliXBlock z) (pauliZBlock z)
   786	    (pauliRXBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)
   787	
   788	/-- The answer constructor prescribed by each Pauli question type; this is the
   789	well-formedness part of `def:pauli-win-predicate`, blueprint
   790	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:331-367`, paper origin
   791	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1225`.
   792	-/
   793	def validPauliAnswer {P : AdmissibleParams} (t : PauliType) (a : PauliAnswer P) : Bool :=
   794	  match t, a with
   795	  | .point _, .value _ => true
   796	  | .aline _, .alinePoly _ => true
   797	  | .dline _, .dlinePoly _ => true
   798	  | .pauli _, .pauliOutcome _ => true
   799	  | .pairW _, .bit _ => true
   800	  | .pair, .pairBits _ => true
   801	  | .ms (.constraint _), .msTriple _ => true
   802	  | .ms (.var _), .bit _ => true
   803	  | _, _ => false
   804	
   805	/-- The axis-line versus point relation used by `def:pauli-win-predicate`,
   806	blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:331-367`, paper origin
   807	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1225`.
   808	-/
   809	def pauliAlinePointCondition (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   810	    (line point : PauliSpace P) (f : Fin (P.d + 1) → PauliScalar P)
   811	    (a : PauliScalar P) : Prop :=
   812	  -- The universal form preserves the source's zero-direction convention.
   813	  ∀ t : PauliScalar P,
   814	    pauliPointBlock W point =
   815	        pauliPointBlock W line + t • coordinateDirection
   816	          (chiIndex P.toLdParams (pauliScalarBlock line)) →
   817	      evalCoefficient f t = a
   818	
   819	/-- The diagonal-line versus point relation used by `def:pauli-win-predicate`,
   820	blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:331-367`, paper origin
   821	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1225`.
   822	-/
   823	def pauliDlinePointCondition (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   824	    (line point : PauliSpace P) (f : Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → PauliScalar P)
   825	    (a : PauliScalar P) : Prop :=
   826	  ∀ t : PauliScalar P,
   827	    pauliPointBlock W point = pauliPointBlock W line +
   828	        t • pauliDirectionBlock line →
   829	      evalCoefficient f t = a
   830	
   831	/-- The raw Pauli-versus-point consistency relation from `def:pauli-win-predicate`,
   832	blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:331-367`, paper origin
   833	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1225`.
   834	-/
   835	def pauliPointPauliCondition (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   836	    (point : PauliSpace P) (h : PauliRegister P) (a : PauliScalar P) : Prop :=
   837	  lowDegreeEnc h (pauliPointBlock W point) = a
   838	
   839	/-- The Pair/W consistency relation, including the one-sided gamma gate, from
   840	`def:pauli-win-predicate`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:331-367`, paper origin
   841	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1225`.
   842	-/
   843	def pauliPairCondition (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   844	    (z : PauliSpace P) (β : ZMod 2) (bits : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) : Prop :=
   845	  pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0 ∨
   846	    (match W with
   847	    | .X => bits.1 = β
   848	    | .Z => bits.2 = β)
   849	
   850	/-- The point/Pair/W trace consistency relation from `def:pauli-win-predicate`,
   851	blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:331-367`, paper origin
   852	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1225`.
   853	-/
   854	def pauliPointPairCondition (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   855	    (z : PauliSpace P) (a : PauliScalar P) (β : ZMod 2) : Prop :=
   856	  pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0 ∨
   857	    fixedBinTrace P.model
   858	      (a * (match W with
   859	      | .X => pauliRXBlock z
   860	      | .Z => pauliRZBlock z)) = β
   861	
   862	/-- The Point/Variable consistency clause of `def:pauli-win-predicate`.
   863	The check is gated by `gamma = 0` and only uses Variable 1 in the X basis or
   864	Variable 5 in the Z basis.  Blueprint
   865	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:331-367`; paper origin
   866	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1225`.
   867	-/
   868	def pauliPointVariableCondition (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   869	    (z : PauliSpace P) (j : Fin 9) (a : PauliScalar P) (β : ZMod 2) : Prop :=
   870	  pauliPairGamma P z = 0 ∨
   871	    (j = ⟨0, by decide⟩ ∧ W = .X ∧
   872	        fixedBinTrace P.model (a * pauliRXBlock z) = β) ∨
   873	    (j = ⟨4, by decide⟩ ∧ W = .Z ∧
   874	        fixedBinTrace P.model (a * pauliRZBlock z) = β)
   875	
   876	/-- The Pauli win predicate, with constructor-shape rejection.  This is
   877	`def:pauli-win-predicate` in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:331-367`,
   878	paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1225`.
   879	-/
   880	noncomputable def pauliWinPredicate (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   881	    PauliQuestion P → PauliQuestion P → PauliAnswer P → PauliAnswer P → Bool :=
   882	  open Classical in
   883	  fun (tA, xA) (tB, xB) a b =>
   884	    if validPauliAnswer tA a && validPauliAnswer tB b then
   885	      if tA = tB then
   886	        decide (a = b)
   887	      else
   888	        match tA, tB, a, b with
   889	      | .aline W, .point W', .alinePoly f, .value u =>
   890	          if W = W' then decide (pauliAlinePointCondition P W xA xB f u) else true
   891	      | .point W, .aline W', .value u, .alinePoly f =>
   892	          if W = W' then decide (pauliAlinePointCondition P W xB xA f u) else true
   893	      | .dline W, .point W', .dlinePoly f, .value u =>
   894	          if W = W' then decide (pauliDlinePointCondition P W xA xB f u) else true
   895	      | .point W, .dline W', .value u, .dlinePoly f =>
   896	          if W = W' then decide (pauliDlinePointCondition P W xB xA f u) else true
   897	      | .point W, .pauli W', .value u, .pauliOutcome h =>
   898	          if W = W' then decide (pauliPointPauliCondition P W xA h u) else true
   899	      | .pauli W, .point W', .pauliOutcome h, .value u =>
   900	          if W = W' then decide (pauliPointPauliCondition P W xB h u) else true
   901	      | .pairW W, .pair, .bit β, .pairBits bits =>
   902	          decide (pauliPairCondition P W xA β bits)
   903	      | .pair, .pairW W, .pairBits bits, .bit β =>
   904	          decide (pauliPairCondition P W xB β bits)
   905	      | .point W, .pairW W', .value u, .bit β =>
   906	          if W = W' then decide (pauliPointPairCondition P W xB u β) else true
   907	      | .pairW W, .point W', .bit β, .value u =>
   908	          if W = W' then decide (pauliPointPairCondition P W xA u β) else true
   909	      | .ms (.constraint i), .ms (.var j), .msTriple β, .bit γ =>
   910	          if ∃ k : Fin 3, msConstraintVars i k = j then
   911	            decide (pauliPairGamma P xA = 0 ∨
   912	              msWinPredicate (.constraint i) (.var j) (.triple β) (.bit γ))
   913	          else true
   914	      | .ms (.var j), .ms (.constraint i), .bit γ, .msTriple β =>
   915	          if ∃ k : Fin 3, msConstraintVars i k = j then
   916	            decide (pauliPairGamma P xB = 0 ∨
   917	              msWinPredicate (.var j) (.constraint i) (.bit γ) (.triple β))
   918	          else true
   919	      | .point W, .ms (.var j), .value u, .bit β =>
   920	          decide (pauliPointVariableCondition P W xB j u β)
   921	      | .ms (.var j), .point W, .bit β, .value u =>
   922	          decide (pauliPointVariableCondition P W xA j u β)
   923	        | _, _, _, _ => true
   924	    else false
   925	
   926	/-- The Pauli basis test game.  This is `def:pauli-question-distribution` and
   927	`def:pauli-win-predicate` packaged as the symmetric game of
   928	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:285-367`, paper origin
   929	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:964-1225`.
   930	-/
   931	noncomputable def pauliBasisTest (P : AdmissibleParams) : Game where
   932	  QuestionA := PauliQuestion P
   933	  QuestionB := PauliQuestion P
   934	  AnswerA := PauliAnswer P
   935	  AnswerB := PauliAnswer P
   936	  μ := pauliQuestionDistribution P
   937	  μ_prob := by
   938	    classical
   939	    letI : Nonempty PauliEdge := pauliEdge_nonempty
   940	    exact Distribution.IsProbability.map
   941	      (uniformDistribution_isProbability (PauliEdge × PauliSpace P)) _
   942	  decide := pauliWinPredicate P
   943	
   944	end

+private theorem isCondLinearOn_one_of_linear {K ι : Type*} [Field K]
+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (L : (ι → K) →ₗ[K] (ι → K)) :
+    IsCondLinearOn K Finset.univ 1 (fun x => L x) := by
+  refine ⟨.succ Finset.univ L (fun _ i hi => absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) hi)

+    funext i
+    simp [coordinateRestriction]
+  show L (coordinateRestriction Finset.univ x) + 0 = L x
+  rw [hx, add_zero]

+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: extend a coefficient vector along an injective

+private def clExtend {K κ ι : Type*} [Zero K] (f : κ → ι) (u : κ → K) : ι → K :=
+  Function.extend f u 0

+  hf.extend_apply u 0 k

  μ_prob := by

`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:285-367`, paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:964-1225`.
-/
noncomputable def pauliBasisTest (P : AdmissibleParams) : Game where
  QuestionA := PauliQuestion P
  QuestionB := PauliQuestion P
  AnswerA := PauliAnswer P
  AnswerB := PauliAnswer P
  μ := pauliQuestionDistribution P
  μ_prob := by
    classical
    letI : Nonempty PauliEdge := pauliEdge_nonempty
    exact Distribution.IsProbability.map
      (uniformDistribution_isProbability (PauliEdge × PauliSpace P)) _
  decide := pauliWinPredicate P

end

+        show clExtend f (L₁ (fun k => coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x (f k))) = _
+        rw [hres]
+      have hcomp : (fun k => clReindexLinear hf L₁
+            (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) (f k)) =
+          L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k))) := by
+        rw [hhead]
+        exact clExtend_comp hf _
+      show clReindexLinear hf L₁ (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) +
+          CondLinearTerm.eval (clReindexTerm hf (rest
+            (fun k => clReindexLinear hf L₁
+              (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) (f k)))) x =
+        clExtend f (L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k))) +
+          CondLinearTerm.eval
+            (rest (L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k)))))
+            (fun k => x (f k)))
+      rw [hcomp, ih _ x, hhead, ← clExtend_add hf]
+
+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: conditional linearity is preserved by an
+injective reindexing of registers, the coordinates outside the image of the
+reindexing being set to zero. -/
+private theorem isCondLinearOn_reindex {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K]
+    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι}
+    (hf : Function.Injective f) {ell : ℕ} {L : (κ → K) → (κ → K)}
+    (h : IsCondLinearOn K Finset.univ ell L) :
+    IsCondLinearOn K Finset.univ ell
+      (fun x => clExtend f (L (fun k => x (f k)))) := by
+  obtain ⟨t, hsupp, hval⟩ := h
+  refine ⟨clReindexTerm hf t,
+    clReindexTerm_supportedOn hf t Finset.univ Finset.univ hsupp
+      (Finset.subset_univ _), ?_⟩
+  funext x
+  rw [clReindexTerm_eval hf t x, hval]
+
+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the point projection of the ambient low-degree
+coefficient space, presented as a linear map.  It is the map `L_Point` of
+`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-49`, paper
+origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`. -/
+private def ldPointProjection (P : LdParams) :
+    LdSpace P →ₗ[ScalarQ P] LdSpace P where
+  toFun z := ldPointCL P z
+  map_add' x y := by
+    funext i
+    rcases i with (j | u) | j <;> simp [ldPointCL]
+  map_smul' c x := by
+    funext i
+    rcases i with (j | u) | j <;> simp [ldPointCL]
+
+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the point map of the low-degree question
+distribution is conditionally linear of level one, as asserted for `L_Point` in
+`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
+`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-49`, paper origin
+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
+It is recorded here because only the Pauli reindexing uses it. -/
+private theorem isCondLinear_ldPointCL (P : LdParams) :
+    IsCondLinearOn (ScalarQ P) Finset.univ 1 (ldPointCL P) :=
+  isCondLinearOn_one_of_linear (ldPointProjection P)
+
+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the type-4 projection of the ambient Pauli
+coefficient space, presented as a linear map; see `pauliSharedProjection` and
+`def:pauli-question-distribution`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:285-329`,
+paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:964-1120`. -/
+private def pauliSharedProjectionLinear (P : AdmissibleParams) :
+    PauliSpace P →ₗ[PauliScalar P] PauliSpace P where
+  toFun z := pauliSharedProjection z
+  map_add' x y := by
+    funext i
+    rcases i with ((((j | j) | u) | j) | u) | u <;> simp [pauliSharedProjection]
+  map_smul' c x := by
+    funext i
+    rcases i with ((((j | j) | u) | j) | u) | u <;> simp [pauliSharedProjection]
+
